note: X50 Ultra (G0111): the stock X50 settings tree (newsettings settings_tree_product_dianapro = res/k0.json; dianamax rF.json is byte-identical) and the stock X50 game menu (xhplayer BaseConfigKt.getDianaConfigListV2), mapped in devices/g0111/research/X50_MENU_D.md. Eye protection: off / follow / be at ease (stock more_eye_state). No fit-now action, no fit-to-screen page, no sound enhancement, equalizer, leveling, launcher choice in this port; no projector settings page (the X50 has no Lumen screen for it: the old X50 menu stays only as the menu over the eye-protection cover). HDMI-CEC: the shared page (apps/core/lumen-cec) with the three rows of the stock signal_setting_control_cec page, CEC control, turn on with an HDMI device, switch to a device when it turns on (driver X50Cec, GmTvManager 52 / 53 and the framework settings as stock). Level angles while the keystone page is open (the stock angle dialog calls); sleep timer and remote pairing are pages of the app. Light rows as this model's stock has them (X50Projector StockLight, evidence in devices/g0111/research/LIGHT_ROWS_STOCK.md): light source level 1..10 (DisplayManager 6/7, the Boost read 152, no Boost step: the boost setter 151 is not allowed, a Boost set in stock stays and the slider refuses). Iris (stock node picture_iris_ring_adjustment_diana, first row of the stock image page under the light level): dynamic, f/2.0, f/3.0, f/4.0, f/5.5, f/7.0 in the stock order on GmTvManager 199/200 (values 0 dynamic, 20, 30, 40, 55, 70). While it reads dynamic, f/5.5 or f/7.0 the light level is refused with the stock note (IrisRule), the iris is refused in the office and performance picture modes (stock SettingMutexManager). Dynamic black (172/174), never in the PC, office or HDR Vivid picture mode. Game menu (adapter apps/X50Projector/src/org/lumen/projector/panel/X50GameIo.java, stock calls with file and line in devices/g0111/research/X50_GAME_CALLS.md): speed and HFR on DisplayManager 76 / 77; VRR, game picture, dark scenes, super resolution, game sound and the frame counter on GmTvManager 145..150 / 120..122, GmAudioManager 75 / 76 and DisplayManager 179, each new call gated (its getter answered in range this boot first, every write read back, a disagreeing read-back closes the item); game sound offers off / surround / story (the stock clarity and balance are not in the module); the aspect ratio item left out of the game menu (its call, GmTvManager 35 / 36, is the picture.aspect row below); none of these items is laser related, so the Ultra Max has the same list. The family picture rows of the stock picture page (X50Projector ProPictureHal, stock calls in devices/g0111/research/allowed_x50projector.tsv): colour temperature standard / movie / D65 (DisplayManager 4/5 as stock choiceLedMode, refused in the office mode), colour optimisation, gamma (the content's own curve or manual) with its manual value 1.8..2.6, HDR dynamic tone mapping (HDR10 only, never in IMAX), local contrast, noise reduction, reset this picture mode and reset all after the stock question, colour optimisation and local contrast hidden while HDR plays (stock PictureFactory). The senior colour row of the stock General page (GmTvManager 179..182, refused in the office, performance and colour accuracy modes). The family rows first ported for the RS30 (X50Projector PictureHal, the same nodes and calls in the X50 newsettings v1.2.64 tree: image_mode_motion_compensation_v4, picture_gamut_diana, image_ai_contrast, picture_super_resolution_switch, picture_anti_rbe with feature supported_rainbow_reduction true): motion compensation off / weak / medium / strong and the original frame (160 (0, 1) behind the stock mutex: not with Ultra 120 Hz, not in 3D, no setOutputTiming as feature real_cinema_mode is 1 on this model as on the RS30), colour gamut native / BT.2020 / DCI-P3 / BT.709 (the diana map has no Adobe RGB; refused in the office mode and under Boost, support_colorspace_boost absent), AI contrast (gone while HDR plays), super resolution, rainbow reduction (one switch here; the Titan dianahy tree adds standard / enhanced under it). Aspect ratio auto / 4:3 / 16:9 / original size on the HDMI part of the picture page (stock image_ratio_info of the signal page: newsettings PictureRepository.setImageRatio -> GmDisplayManager.setVideoRatioCommon -> XgimiService MtkVideo.setZoomMode -> GmTvManager 35 setAspectRatio, read 36; GMPF2 values auto 2, 4:3 0, 16:9 1, original 4), on an HDMI input only (support_aspectratio_overall absent), refused in the game picture mode and while the game mode is on (checkImageRatioMutex). The stock picture settings page rule (SettingMutexManager image_mode_setting, the same in the X50, RS30 and Titan newsettings): its rows refuse every write while the game mode is on (148 state 0) and in the AI or performance picture mode unless Dolby Vision plays (lumen-menu PictureSettingsRule). The colour and screen pages of the stock picture page (X50Projector ColorHal, rs30-parity-picture2): white balance with its 2-point page (red, green and blue gain and offset, GmTvManager 17..28) and 11-point page (grey level 5 .. 100 %, red, green, blue; 165 / 166), colour correction (colour, hue, saturation, lightness; 117 / 118), each with the stock Reset to defaults (164 with the page's class), the HDR enhancement page (tone mapping, screen size and gain, 185 / 186) shown while HDR plays and it is not Dolby Vision, the Dolby Vision screen page (size and gain, 73 / 76 / 77) usable only while Dolby Vision plays, the auto mode switch (162 / 163), and the style filter row only while a filter set on stock is in use, offering the way back to the model's original cube (154); the stock filter catalogue is XGIMI's online service and is not in Lumen. No custom picture mode rows: no tree of this family creates one. Eye-protection safety stays in X50EyeGuard; the menu only sends the stock user-row calls. 3D: the six modes of the stock tree (image_3d_info_state: close, lr, tb, lrTo2d, tbTo2d, frame_packing), sent as stock PictureRepository.setImage3D (DisplayManager 22 enable3D, 23 enable3DTo2D, read back by 24 / 25) behind its refusal list (X50Projector X50ThreeD), so the 3D tile takes the network place and network goes to the top row. rs30-parity-projection: the picture rotation page (stock RotateWind: 147 open, 142 read, 134 by 0.5 degree, the reset by the session angle, 185(true / false, 0) around the first key), the corner page inside the stock KeyStoneWind session (147, the move auto keystone paused, 185 type 0), the remote focus picture row (stock remote_focus_img_guide, our own drawing), and Auto keystone, corners, zoom, shift and rotation refused at top game speed with the stock toast (common.json gameModeFast). The stock lens memory list (lens_memory: 111 / 121 reads, 109 save, 108 rename and save again, 110 delete, 107 go back; gsi-research/RS30_PARITY_PROJECTION.md says why 107-110 are unbanned for this app).
